posts.title: Carmelites in Iron Mountain Celebrate 75th Anniversary

posts.title: Foundress of the Parish Visitors of Mary Immaculate Declared Venerable
posts.description: In June, the Parish Visitors of Mary Immaculate received the joyous news that their foundress, Mother Mary Teresa Tallon, had been declared Venerable by Pope Leo XIV.
